# Vuorikosken Mylly

> A water mill built in 1893 in Myllykylä, Sammatti, in the town of Lohja, Uusimaa, Finland. Today it is a summer café with a gluten-free spread of bakes (plus wheat cinnamon buns on a separate table), a second-hand interior and vintage clothing shop, a summer art gallery, a small event room and two small off-grid B&B cabins by the mill pond. Open in the summer season and on Advent weekends before Christmas.

- Address: Tavolantie 18, 09220 Sammatti (Lohja), Finland
- Phone and WhatsApp: +358 44 016 5047
- Email: antti.jakola@hotmail.com
- Bus: Lohja to Sammatti, Myllykylä stop, then a 200 m walk

## Pages

- [Café](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/cafe): gluten-free sweet and savoury bakes made on the farm, plus fresh wheat cinnamon buns; own mango-citrus iced tea and iced latte; pets welcome.
- [Vintage shop](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/vintage-shop): second-hand interiors, vintage clothing, the farm's artisan treats, local crafts; Christmas shop on Advent weekends.
- [Art gallery](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/art-gallery): four artists each summer; room hire €100 for 8 days, 25% commission.
- [Event room](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/event-room): long table for meetings and small family parties in summer, €50 per hour.
- [Stay](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/stay): Mutterimökki and Rantayksiö, 1–2 people, €59 a night with bed linen, no electricity; breakfast €10, shore sauna €7 with a stay or €10 without.
- [Hours and contact](https://www.vuorikoskenmylly.com/en/contact)
